description: This file defines the internal interface and data structures for a radix tree implementation used by jemalloc to track memory ownership, including type definitions, structure declarations, function prototypes, and inline functions.

methods.name: rtree_new
methods.description: Creates a new radix tree with specified bits and allocators.

methods.name: rtree_delete
methods.description: Deletes a radix tree and frees resources.

methods.name: rtree_prefork
methods.description: Prepares the radix tree for a fork operation.

methods.name: rtree_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key in the radix tree.

methods.name: rtree_set
methods.description: Sets a value for a key in the radix tree.
